description: Get historical VRP time series: daily ATM IV, realized vol (5/10/20/30d), VRP, straddle price, and expected move for charting and backtesting.

apiKey.description: FlashAlpha API key. Omit when calling via /mcp-oauth (OAuth flow); required on /mcp.

days.description: Number of days of legacy persisted history (default 30, max 365)

end.description: Normalized range end YYYY-MM-DD; at most 366 calendar days.

series.description: legacy (default) or normalized constant-tenor reconstructed history; normalized requires start/end instead of days. normalized is release pending (503 daily_series_disabled until enabled).

start.description: Normalized range start YYYY-MM-DD; SPY/QQQ, completed dates only.

tenor_days.description: Normalized IV tenor in calendar days: 30, 60 or 90.

name: get_vrp_history
title: Get VRP History
